task.title: Installing the plugin
task.shortdesc: Install the plugin into a DITA Open Toolkit with a single command; there are no other dependencies.

prereq.p: You need the version 4.4.1 or later, running on Java 17 or later. No Node.js, no package managers, and no network access at build time.

step.cmd: Install the plugin by name from the DITA-OT plugin registry.

info.p: The toolkit looks the name up in the registry, downloads the current release and checks it against the registry's checksum. To install a particular release, or on a machine without access to the registry, give the release asset's URL or a downloaded zip instead:
info.note: Run the command from a directory that does not contain a folder called org.istanduk.gov-uk — for example, not from a checkout of the plugin's source — because the toolkit treats a matching local path as the thing to install rather than as a registry name.

step.cmd: Confirm the govuk format is available.

result.p: The toolkit can now build any DITA map with --format=govuk.
result.note: To upgrade to a newer release, uninstall first — the toolkit refuses to replace an installed plugin and leaves the old version in place:
result.codeblock: dita uninstall org.istanduk.gov-uk dita install <newer release URL>
